reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing Experience – We Cannot Recommend Brevo
reviews.text: As a large Danish company, we chose Brevo expecting a professional email marketing platform with competent support and clear guidance. Unfortunately, our experience has been the exact opposite. Our account has been suspended multiple times, despite the fact that we continuously worked to improve our email performance and followed every recommendation we received. Instead of constructive dialogue, we were met with arrogant and dismissive support. What was most frustrating was the complete lack of guidance. We repeatedly asked for specific targets regarding acceptable bounce rates and unsubscribe rates, but Brevo never provided clear benchmarks or measurable requirements. Instead, our account was repeatedly threatened with closure and eventually suspended again, without meaningful explanations or a realistic opportunity to resolve the issues. It is important to emphasize that **all of our contacts are collected legally** through double opt-in. Every subscriber has actively signed up via our website, social media campaigns, or quizzes. We do not purchase email lists, nor do we send unsolicited emails. We expected a partner that would help us improve our deliverability and compliance. Instead, we experienced: * Arrogant and unhelpful customer support. * No practical guidance on reducing bounce or unsubscribe rates. * Repeated account suspensions despite making significant improvements. * No clear performance thresholds or transparent policies. * No willingness to listen, advise, or support us. * Repeated threats of account closure with little or no explanation. For a company that markets itself as a professional email marketing solution, this level of customer service is simply unacceptable. We absolutely cannot recommend Brevo to businesses that value transparency, partnership, and professional support. There are many other email marketing providers that genuinely work with their customers instead of against them.

J'ai demandé explicitement une review humaine par l'équipe deliverability. Toujours aucune réponse humaine, et la suspension reste affichée comme "définitive". Je rappelle aussi que mes autres métriques sont saines : taux de clic 6,88% (bien au-dessus des 3% recommandés), engagement négatif 0,02% (bien en-dessous du seuil 0,1%).
